We are looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to make Foley’s go-to-market engine truly AI-native. Not someone who can talk about AI agents for outbound, but someone who has built them, put them in front of real buyers, and can show us what they did to pipeline, conversion, or cost per lead.

Foley helps companies hire, screen, and monitor drivers through DOT and FMCSA compliance, MVRs, drug and alcohol testing, background checks, and the Clearinghouse. Our customers range from a five-truck owner-operator buying online at night to national fleets with procurement teams, and we sell to both. You’ll be the growth engineer for our entire go-to-market team: marketing, product marketing, and sales. Behind you is a live AI platform, a governed path to production, and a small team of builders already shipping.

This is a generator role, not a coordinator role. You take a hypothesis, turn it into an experiment, build what it needs, ship it, and read the result. Take away the agency, the vendors, and the ticket queue, and you can still move pipeline with a laptop, an API key, and access to the CRM.

What You’ll Do
Run the Growth Experiment Engine
Turn marketing, product marketing, and sales hypotheses into experiments across messaging, channels, targeting, offers, pricing pages, and sales plays

Design experiments with a control, a metric chosen in advance, and enough volume to trust the result

Run a high volume of tests, kill losers fast, scale winners, and maintain a learning log so no test runs twice

Build the Agents That Do the Work
Build research and enrichment agents that know an account before a rep does

Build signal and trigger detection for events like new DOT authority, fleet growth, safety events, and upcoming renewals

Own lead scoring, qualification, and routing so every lead is worked by the right person or agent

Run personalized outbound and lifecycle programs at scale, with deliverability you own

Instrument tracking and attribution so we can see what’s working

Support Product Marketing
Test positioning and messaging against real buyers

Launch with targeting, pages, and follow-up already wired

Turn sales calls, win/loss data, and competitor moves into insight product marketing can use

Build content and SEO/GEO tooling so our compliance expertise shows up where buyers are looking

Support Sales
Deliver prospect research and account prep reps don’t have time for

Surface signals that tell reps who to call and why now

Build tools that cut admin time and give reps more time to sell

Make sure smaller deals get worked by systems built to work them well

Build on the Platform, Not Around It
Build go-to-market agents on Foley’s AI platform and shared ontology rather than a separate growth stack

Contribute connectors, skills, and signals other teams can reuse

Add go-to-market concepts to the ontology so marketing, sales, customer success, and product describe every account the same way

Operate with Judgment & Guardrails
Ship everything through our review and release gates

Handle consent, PII, and email/SMS/calling rules from day one

Build systems that are still running and trusted six months from now

Contribute to the Team
Participate in marketing, product marketing, and sales meetings as part of the team; their leaders set the priorities

Partner with RevOps, the data team, and other builders across Foley

Share what you build and help the people around you move faster

Who You Are
We’re looking for builders with proven results. When we ask what your work did to the number, your answer is a number.

You might come from:

GTM Engineer: You built the outbound and enrichment machine at a startup or scale-up, owned deliverability, and can tell us exactly what it did to pipeline, including how you handled a bad week

Growth Engineer: You ran experimentation, instrumentation, and attribution for a product or funnel, and want to apply it to a sales-led and self-serve motion at the same time

Founder or Operator Turned Builder: You stood up a go-to-market motion from zero, built the agents and landing pages yourself, and grew a number

Must-haves

You have driven measurable growth results with AI and agents (pipeline, meetings, conversion, cost per lead or acquisition, or revenue) and can explain how you measured them

You have designed and run many experiments, understand what control groups and sample sizes are for, and can walk us through tests that failed

You build it yourself, using Python, SQL, APIs, webhooks, LLMs, agents, and Claude Code or similar

You have hands-on experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar), plus enrichment and sequencing tools

You understand how B2B demand is created and converted, and what a good lead, message, and sales play look like

You have contributed to a shared platform, data model, or internal tooling other teams relied on

Marketers, product marketers, reps, and sales leaders trust what you build and like working with you

Strong Signals

You’ve stood up a motion, product, or company from zero

You’ve worked on small business and self-serve funnels alongside a sales-led motion

You have product marketing experience in positioning, launches, competitive intel, or win/loss

You have a current point of view on SEO and generative engine optimization

You’ve turned Gong or call data into signals or content

You’ve built evals or observability for an AI system

You’ve done ontology, knowledge graph, or semantic layer work modeling accounts, entities, or GTM concepts

You’ve worked in transportation, compliance, regtech, or another regulated market

Location: This role is primarily remote (US based), with the expectation of occasional visits to our offices for team collaboration, training, or company events.

This role may be based remotely out of the following states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Indiana, Kansas, Massachusetts, Maryland, Michigan, Missouri, Nebraska, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, Wisconsin

About us
At Foley, we’re reimagining how safety-sensitive industries hire, stay compliant, and manage risk. We’ve evolved into a modern SaaS company with an all-in-one, AI-ready platform that helps transportation, construction, distribution, and utility businesses operate faster, smarter, and safer.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for curious, strategic thinkers who thrive in complexity, are motivated by making an impact, and want to join a team that’s passionate about building great products and supporting customers. Our core values — Teammateship, Grit, and Innovation — guide everything we do. Whether we’re collaborating internally or helping customers, we approach every challenge with optimism, humor, and a shared commitment to success.
